description: Default permissions for the main window. Every command this app defines is callable without a permission; this covers the Tauri core itself. There are deliberately no plugin permissions: this app has no dialogs, no filesystem access, no microphone and no opener. The one request this app can make off the machine — an optional model check — is made in Rust rather than by the webview, which is why it needs no permission here and why the interface can neither name a URL nor read the key.
